Bhopal sealing action: Properties identified, CM assures court representation

Authorities in Bhopal have identified approximately 65,000 properties for sealing action, with 576 colonies reportedly located on Nazul or unapproved layouts. Chief Minister Mohan Yadav stated that the government will present its case in the Supreme Court and seek a better solution regarding the sealing drive. The sealing action is reportedly intensifying in Bhopal.
